sections.title: Information Collection
sections.content: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when contacting us or using our services, such as name, contact information, and case details.

sections.title: Use of Information
sections.content: We use your personal information to provide the requested legal services, communicate with you regarding your case, and improve our services.

sections.title: Information Protection
sections.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.title: Information Sharing
sections.content: We do not share your personal information with third parties except with your consent or when required by law.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can contact us to exercise these rights.
